headline: Committee closes oral testimony, takes lunch recess before criteria discussion

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: A testifier who bought a unit at Kīhei Gardens Estate in 2024 said she supports the resolutions but wishes her unit were included. Written testimony will still be accepted, and members plan to discuss criteria when they return at 2.
meeting.recap: The testifier said she is a local resident of Maui.[[0:03:15]] She said her own unit has not been moved into a resolution yet.[[0:04:31]] She said that with 3.2 feet of sea level rise, the roads and parking lot at her building are covered.[[0:04:39]] She said her family would lose about $100,000 if they tried to sell the unit.[[0:05:31]] She said she supports the resolutions but wishes her unit were included.[[0:06:10]] She said she bought the unit at Kīhei Gardens Estate in 2024.[[0:06:48]] She told a member she uses the unit as a short-term rental.[[0:07:36]] No one else asked to testify at the last call.[[0:08:03]] The committee closed oral testimony with no objections.[[0:08:19]] Written testimony will still be accepted.[[0:08:28]] The chair said members will begin discussing criteria for these properties after lunch.[[0:09:35]] A member asked to discuss conditions as well as criteria.[[0:09:49]]
decided: The committee closed oral testimony with no objections.
meeting.next: Members will begin discussing criteria for these properties when they return at 2. The chair said the chair will talk with staff during lunch about how to continue the conversation. Written testimony will continue to be accepted.

moments.q: "So I am in support of these resolutions. I wish my unit was on it"
